prepare your boat

To get started, you'll need a wallet that supports Binance Smart Chain (BSC). We recommend MetaMask or Trust Wallet. Simply download the wallet app and create a new account. Make sure to securely save your recovery phrase—safety first!

find your perfect pond

To buy Ducky, you’ll need BNB in your wallet. You can purchase BNB on exchanges like Binance and transfer it to your wallet. Make sure you have a little extra BNB to cover the transaction fees! Remember to switch your network to BSC in your wallet.

make the swa(m)p

Go to PancakeSwap, connect your wallet, and select BNB as the token you want to swap. Search for Ducky by pasting the token address, enter the amount of BNB you want to exchange, and click "Swap." Confirm the transaction in your wallet, and you’re all set.

Congratulations, you’re now part of the Duck Squad! Holding your Ducky coins means you're joining a fun, fearless community. Like a duck gliding through calm waters, you can relax and watch your duck grow.
